name: Kneeling Push-Up
steps: Kneel with your hands just wider than shoulder width and shift your shoulders above your wrists.
Brace your abdomen and align your head, hips and knees.
Bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your ribs to lower your chest smoothly toward the floor.
Press forcefully through your palms to extend your arms back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your hips aligned with your shoulders and knees rather than letting your lower back sag or your hips stick up.
Lower your chest between your hands while keeping your neck neutral.
